svg.title: How a recipe decides what happens next
svg.desc: Read down. Follow an arrow when the answer to its question is yes. Run the recipe on the chosen layers. Rollout and training use the initial settings from the first batch. Is periodic observation enabled, and is a check due? Measure the layers in scope for observation. Record the measurements. Observation alone keeps the settings fixed. Does the recipe support changes, and have you allowed them here? Prepare and test a proposed change. Compare it with the current settings on the same inputs. Did the proposal pass validation and get manual or rule-based approval? Apply the approved change for the next batch. The learner applies it and every rollout replica confirms before sampling. At the next scheduled check, return to step 2.
